findings.issue_text: When an organization has no child teams, `userIdsFromOrg` is set to `[]`, preventing organization-level memberships from being queried and omitting members’ individual bookings from organization insights.

goldens.comment: In getBaseConditions(), the else if (filterConditions) and final else branches are unreachable. This is because getAuthorizationConditions() always returns a non-null Prisma.Sql object, making authConditions always truthy, which means only the first two if/else if conditions are ever evaluated.

Fetching userIdsFromOrg only when teamsFromOrg.length > 0 can exclude org-level members for orgs without child teams; consider deriving from teamIds (which includes orgId) or removing the guard so org-only orgs still include member user bookings.

per_golden_matches.reasoning: The candidate issue identifies the exact same problem as the golden comment: when an organization has no child teams, userIdsFromOrg becomes empty ([]), which prevents organization-level members from being included in the query. Both comments point out that this logic flaw causes org-only organizations to miss member user bookings in the insights. The candidate uses slightly different wording but describes the identical underlying bug.
